hero.heading: Designing tactile software & enduring editorial systems.

hero.introduction: I partner with founders, architectural practices, and technical teams to transform complex workflows into calm, legible, high-performance web applications.
hero.profileImageAlt: Clara Vance working in architectural concrete studio

about.subtitle: Bridging typographic craft with systems engineering.
about.description: Trained in industrial typography and distributed systems, I treat software interfaces with the same material rigor as physical objects.
about.biography:
My practice operates at the intersection of editorial direction and full-stack TypeScript engineering. Whether building a bespoke publication engine for an architectural monograph or a real-time analytics instrument for institutional finance, every decision begins with hierarchy, latency, and human clarity.

Previously Lead Design Technologist at Studio Nørd and Senior Frontend Architect at Meridian Systems, I now advise select technology and cultural organizations.

education.details: Thesis on real-time procedural typography and GPU-accelerated layout engines.
Focused on Swiss grid systems, editorial monographs, and interactive media.

experience.summary: Directing end-to-end architecture, brand systems, and full-stack React platforms.
Led the multi-asset terminal UI platform serving 18,000+ daily institutional analysts.
Built interactive digital monographs and WebGL exhibition spaces for Nordic architects.

projects.title: Studio Nørd Architectural Monograph
projects.description: A bespoke digital archive and responsive broadsheet reading experience showcasing twelve coastal concrete residences, complete with instant typographic scale switching and high-resolution plate inspection.

projects.title: Klangwerk Modular Web Synthesizer
projects.description: Browser-native polyphonic synthesizer and hardware companion console engineered with Web Audio Worklets, zero-jitter rotary controls, and low-latency oscilloscope telemetry.

projects.title: Galerie Béton — Luminal Forms
projects.description: Curatorial companion and spatial exhibition catalog for a brutalist light sculpture retrospective, pairing atmospheric gallery documentation with multilingual essay indexing.

projects.title: Meridian Portfolio & Risk Ledger
projects.description: High-density institutional analytics terminal engineered for sub-50ms tabular updates, keyboard-first navigation, and strict WCAG AA legibility across dark and light studio modes.
